prompt:
Design an expressive iOS/macOS Next Event widget for a desktop dashboard. Generate 5 distinct compositions in Small (160x160), Medium (340x160) and Large (340x340). One layout per size, rendered once. Never repeat a row or value.

Compositions (distinct surfaces, palettes & motion):
1 Split Calendar: White (#FFFFFF) 2-column card—left has giant red date ("15"), "Wednesday / Aug", and 6-day strip with pink active circle; right has events with vertical blue/green bars and purple "Go to Meet" pill.
2 Neon Countdown: Pitch black (#111111) card with top-left avatar, coral-red title, grey time subtitle, and huge hot-pink ("25 min") hero with breathing glow.
3 Dot-Matrix Teal: Teal (#178582) card with top 3x10 dot-matrix day grid (pulsing white/yellow lit dots vs dim), white event title, and huge start time.
4 Cobalt Agenda: Vibrant blue (#0A7AFF) card with gradient sweep; stacked rows with left status rings, title + time, and bold right countdowns.
5 Bento Time-Block: White card—top has huge start/end times ("11:30 AM / 12:30 PM") + teal note; bottom has 2 grey (#F2F2F7) sub-cards with link and teal bars.

Hard content limits per size:
Small: title, start time, plus ONE detail (hot-pink countdown, red date, or dot-grid). Max 3 items. No agenda or date strip.
Medium: Small's content plus ONE block: right event block with vertical bar + "Go to Meet" pill, OR 2 sub-cards.
Large: Medium's content plus ONE more block: 3-event agenda list with vertical bars and 6-day strip.
Never squeeze larger content into a smaller size.

Spacing & Visual: 24px squircle; padding 16px Small, 20px Medium/Large; 8px grid, 12px+ group gaps, no clipping. One clear hero per size, other text 11-14px (never <11px). Believable data.
designSpec: A compact gallery presents five composition families across three sizes, displaying each selected variant once at its authored dimensions with 24px corners and size-specific padding. Small tiles retain three content items, Medium adds one meeting panel or bento block, and Large adds three unique agenda entries plus a six-day strip. Distinct palettes, a static neon glow and a cobalt gradient preserve the expressive desktop aesthetic without unsupported animation.
